name: Exage ES
generation: Documented in Shimano’s 1993 manufacturer manuals. The start year records the first reviewed dated range reference, not a claim that the range launched in 1993.

sources.title: Shimano 1993 dealer product manual, PDF page 31 / printed 31: Exage ES exact inventory: RD-M520-SGS 301 g, GS/SGS limits including 20T front difference, ST-M520 complete 3x7 controls 395 g, FC-M520 170 mm 46/36/26T 706 g, CS-HG70-7 E 12–28T 309 g

Shimano 1993 STI technical manual, PDF page 10 / printed 9: named Exage ES/LT front drive: exact M520/M320 cranks, normal/top-route front models, triple controls, bands, 46/36/26T and separate bottom brackets
Shimano 1993 STI technical manual, PDF page 15 / printed 14: named Exage ES/LT cantilever/control table: BR-M520/M320 M arms, BR-M521/M321 L arms, dynamic unit links and 22.2 mm control clamps
